title: リスニング 第1回（単語・入試問題・お話）

chapters.title: パート1 単語・例文
パート2 入試の形の問題

words.ex: I had a great experience in Australia.
words.exja: 私はオーストラリアですばらしい経験をしました。

words.ex: We should do something to protect the environment.
words.exja: 私たちは環境を守るために何かをするべきです。

words.ex: It is important for us to help each other.
words.exja: 私たちにとって、助け合うことは大切です。

words.ex: I decided to join the volunteer club.
words.exja: 私はボランティア部に入ることに決めました。

words.ex: I couldn't understand his question at first.
words.exja: 私は最初、彼の質問を理解できませんでした。

words.ex: Do you remember the name of that shop?
words.exja: あの店の名前を覚えていますか。

words.ex: People have different ideas about this problem.
words.exja: この問題について、人々はさまざまな考えを持っています。
あなたの辞書を借りてもいいですか。

words.ex: The train arrived at the station at seven.
words.exja: 電車は7時に駅に着きました。

words.ex: She continued practicing the piano for ten years.
words.exja: 彼女は10年間ピアノの練習を続けました。

words.ex: We can communicate with people around the world.
words.exja: 私たちは世界中の人々と意思を伝え合うことができます。

words.ex: I'm interested in the culture of other countries.
words.exja: 私は外国の文化に興味があります。

words.ex: Thank you for inviting me to the party.
words.exja: パーティーに招待してくれてありがとう。

words.ex: We prepared for the school festival after school.
words.exja: 私たちは放課後、文化祭の準備をしました。

words.ex: I was surprised to hear the news.
words.exja: 私はその知らせを聞いて驚きました。

words.ex: Don't forget to bring your lunch tomorrow.
words.exja: 明日、お弁当を持ってくるのを忘れないでね。

lines: Yes. I studied until midnight for the math test.
It's tomorrow. After the test, I can play soccer again.
c: He studied late for a test.
He took a math test today.
questions.why: ケンは「数学のテストのために夜中まで勉強した」と言っています。テストは明日なので、C は違います。

lines: Excuse me. How can I get to the city library?
Take the number five bus. It leaves from that bus stop.
About fifteen minutes. The bus comes every twenty minutes.
questions.q: How long does it take to get to the library by bus?
questions.why: How long は「どのくらい時間がかかるか」。About fifteen minutes と言っています。twenty はバスが来る間かくなので、ひっかけです。

lines: Good morning, everyone. This is the student council. Tomorrow, we will clean the park near our school. Please come to the school gate at eight thirty. Bring gloves and a towel. If it rains, we will clean the school gym instead.
questions.q: What will the students do if it rains tomorrow?
c: They will clean the school gym.
They will meet at eight thirty at the park.
questions.why: 最後に If it rains, we will clean the school gym instead.「雨なら代わりに体育館をそうじする」と言っています。instead は「代わりに」。

lines: Mom, have you seen my blue bag?
I saw it on the table in the kitchen this morning.
I looked there, but it wasn't there.
Then, maybe your sister took it to her room. Go and ask her.
questions.q: What will the boy do next?
c: He will look in the kitchen.
He will buy a new bag.
questions.why: お母さんが Go and ask her.「妹（姉）に聞いておいで」と言っています。キッチンはもう探したので、A は違います。

stories.title: Grandfather's Tomatoes
stories.text: Every summer, I help my grandfather in his garden. Last year, he gave me some tomato seeds and said, "Try to grow them by yourself." I gave them water every morning, but they grew very slowly. I was worried and asked him, "Why are my tomatoes so small?" He laughed and said, "Good things take time. Just wait." A few weeks later, I found red tomatoes in my garden. They were small, but they were the most delicious tomatoes I have ever eaten. Now, when something is difficult, I remember his words: good things take time.
stories.ja: おじいさんにトマトの種をもらい、自分で育てた話。なかなか大きくならず心配したけれど、おじいさんは「よいことには時間がかかる。待ちなさい」と言った。数週間後、小さいけれど今まで食べた中でいちばんおいしいトマトがとれた。今でも、むずかしいことがあるとその言葉を思い出す。

stories.title: A Friend from Canada
stories.text: Last spring, a student from Canada came to our class. Her name was Lily. On the first day, I wanted to talk to her, but I was afraid of making mistakes in English. So I just smiled at her. One day, Lily dropped her pencil case, and I picked it up. She said, "Thank you! You are very kind." I answered, "You're welcome. Do you like soccer?" She said, "Yes, I love it!" After that, we talked about soccer every day. My English was not perfect, but she understood me. I learned that the most important thing is to try.
stories.ja: カナダからの留学生リリーと友だちになった話。最初は英語のまちがいがこわくて話しかけられなかった。でも筆箱を拾ってあげたことをきっかけにサッカーの話をするようになり、毎日話すようになった。英語が完ぺきでなくても伝わる。大切なのはやってみることだと学んだ。
